  "overall_experience": "This Billing Specialist likely found Basecamp effective for organizing finance-related tasks, tracking deadlines, and streamlining communication with team members for approvals and project updates. While it excelled at managing workflows and collaboration, the lack of advanced financial reporting meant they still relied on dedicated accounting software for in-depth financial statements. The platform's simplicity and core project management features were appreciated over their two-year usage."
